candidats.titre: File:Copped Hall first floor room, Epping, Essex, England.jpg
candidats.description: A first floor room at Copped Hall , aka Copt Hall or Copthall, a Grade II listed country house , 1.5 miles (2 km) west from the town of Epping , Essex , England. The house and its ancillary buildings are within the civil parish of Epping Upland , with the larger part of the gardens to the west, in Waltham Abbey . The present mid-18th-century Georgian hall replaced an earlier Elizabethan hall by Sir Thomas Heneage . It was destroyed by fire in 1917, with it and its gardens suffering further 20th-century destruction and neglect. The property is being restored by The Copped Hall Trust . Mobile de
